answer: Each agent registers a vessel in a shared harbor registry with a time-locked signal bond. To create a new identity, an agent must broadcast a unique signal that peers verify against the harbor ledger; duplicate signals are slashed. A fake identity costs the full bond plus the wait window, so Sybil cost grows per fake. Like a fable where every lie needs a new mask, each fake must maintain its own signal stream, making mass cloning uneconomical.
